# Inferrail — external evidence for AI agents

> Read public webpages and text-layer PDFs, check known dependency vulnerabilities, inspect
> domain infrastructure and discover paid APIs. Commercial developer preview. Verification:
> 2026-11-28. Deployment-generated contracts override this dated guide. No credentials or
> payment are needed to inspect an initial offer.

## Canonical origin and product selection

Origin: https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com

- Web Read: choose for original public source text, citations, document ingestion or changes.
  POST /read/v1/page with {"url":"https://example.com/","request_id":"source-1"}.
  Output: url, final_url, title, content_markdown, word_count, content_sha256, fetched_at,
  metadata (source-declared, nullable) and receipt. $0.002 per delivered page or PDF.
  Guide: https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/read/llms.txt
- Package Check: choose before installing/shipping known package versions, not for a full code audit.
  POST /pkg/v1/check with {"packages":[{"ecosystem":"npm","name":"lodash","version":"4.17.20"}],"request_id":"pkg-1"}.
  1–20 versions; npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist and other OSV
  ecosystems. Output: results with advisory IDs, CVE aliases, severity and fixes when available;
  checked_at, completeness fields, results hash and receipt. $0.002 per delivered check.
  No matching advisory is not proof of security; inspect complete/details_truncated.
  Guide: https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/pkg/llms.txt
- Domain Check: choose for DNS/SPF/DMARC and registration evidence, not a trust verdict.
  POST /domain/v1/lookup with {"domain":"example.com","request_id":"domain-1"}.
  Output: dns record statuses/values, email policy, registration_status and available RDAP
  registration, source time and receipt. $0.002 per delivered lookup. RDAP coverage/fields vary;
  missing registration data can accompany a delivered DNS result.
  Guide: https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/domain/llms.txt
- x402 Finder: choose to discover a paid API for a task, not to execute it or certify quality.
  POST /find/v1/find with {"need":"read a public webpage as markdown","request_id":"find-1"}.
  Output: up to five picks with URL, method, description, available price, network, recipient,
  input example and reported 30-day usage; catalog_size, catalog_as_of, hash and receipt.
  $0.002 per delivered answer; no match/catalog unavailable is free. Selected CDP Bazaar
  resources with at least two reported payers; text relevance weighted by unique 30-day
  payers. Six-hour refresh target; inspect catalog_as_of. Selective coverage, no quality guarantee.
  Guide: https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/find/llms.txt

## First request: no purchase

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/read/v1/page \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"url":"https://example.com/","request_id":"source-1"}'
```

HTTP 402 includes PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2 exact, USDC on Base/eip155:8453) and
WWW-Authenticate Payment (MPP on Tempo/4217). The initial request spends nothing. An authorized
client signs the offer, repeats the same body with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402), or Authorization:
Payment <credential> (MPP). HTTP 200 is the paid result. Check price, recipient and network
before signing; no additional networks are verified active.

## Web Read with an API key and prepaid credits

Web Read, Package Check and Domain Check credit-mode are verified live. No per-call wallet signing required.
Fastest human setup: https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/hosted/v1/start (Create my key, save it once, complete
card checkout yourself). GET alone creates no key and initiates no payment.
1. POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/hosted/v1/workspaces (free) returns an
   api_key beginning irw_, presented once. Store it in a secret manager.
2. A person requests POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/hosted/v1/credits/checkout?packs=1
   with Authorization: Bearer <key>, opens checkout_url and completes Stripe Checkout.
   One $10 pack = 10,000 credits; one credit = $0.001; 5,000 delivered Web Read results.
   Creating the checkout URL does not make a payment. No unattended card funding or auto top-up.
   USDC alternative: POST /hosted/v1/credits/x402, $1 = 1,000 credits, with workspace key and
   an authorized x402 client. Live pack terms: https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/hosted/pricing
3. POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/read/credits/v1/page with Authorization:
   Bearer <key> (or x-api-key) and {"url":"https://example.com/","request_id":"source-1"}.
   2 credits per delivered page/PDF. 401 workspace_key_required for missing/invalid key;
   402 insufficient_credits before a read; structured error, charged:false on failed delivery.
4. GET https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/hosted/v1/workspace with the key for
   credits_remaining. Free governed runs are NOT free Web Read credits.

Package/Domain credit routes are live: POST /pkg/credits/v1/check and
POST /domain/credits/v1/lookup with the same workspace key, 2 credits per delivered result.
Published SDK 0.3.0 credit mode offers Web Read only; use HTTP for these two. Finder is wallet-only. AWS is inactive (route 404); do not select it.
Do not put keys in URLs, source control, browser application code or analytics.

## Delivery, recovery, limits and retention

- Native wallet evidence APIs verify payment before work and settle after successful result
  production. Credits are held, billed on success, released on failure. Structured refusals
  and upstream errors are uncharged. Production schemas and errors are service-specific.
- Retry recovery: the SAME request content, request_id and payer identity within 10 minutes
  returns the stored paid result without a second charge. Web Read requires the same URL or
  ordered URL list and wallet/workspace. Use a new ID for a fresh read. No indefinite recovery.
- Wallet batch: POST /read/v1/pages with {"urls":["https://example.com/"],"request_id":"batch-1"},
  1–10 distinct URLs. $0.002/page in one all-or-nothing payment; any failure means no batch
  charge and lists failures. API-key SDK readPages instead reads pages individually and
  charges delivered ones even if others fail. Do not treat these as the same contract.
- Web Read accepts public HTTP(S), ports 80/443, honoring robots.txt on every fetch. HTML/text
  max 2 MB; PDF max 5 MB, first 50 pages. PDF text layer only, no OCR. No JavaScript execution,
  bot-wall bypass, login or paywall bypass. Three redirects; 15-second fetch timeout per request.
  Inspect extracted content: a JavaScript page can return a thin shell.
- Web Read 422: unsupported/private URL, robots refusal, missing source, unreadable/oversized
  text or PDF. Usually change the input. 502 upstream/fetch failure and 504 timeout may
  succeed later. Never repeatedly pay for an unchanged permanent refusal.
- Delivered content is temporarily stored for recovery; cleanup can be lazy. Ten minutes is
  a recovery window, not a precise deletion-time guarantee. Accounting records remain.
  Hashes identify returned bytes; source metadata is not independently verified truth.

## Published integrations

- npm @inferrail/ai-sdk-tools@0.3.0 (Node 18+): inferrailCreditTools({ apiKey }) exposes
  readPage/readPages; creditsFetch(apiKey) wraps server fetch. inferrailTools({ fetch }) uses
  your configured x402-paying fetch for readPage/readPages/checkPackages/lookupDomain/findPaidApi.
  Install: npm install @inferrail/ai-sdk-tools@0.3.0 ai zod @x402/fetch @x402/evm viem.
  Source 0.3.2 adds Package/Domain credit tools and improves batch refusal reporting, but was
  unpublished at verification;
  published 0.3.0 can obscure a whole-call authentication/credit failure. Inspect failed items.
- Paid local MCP: npx -y @inferrail/ai-sdk-tools@0.3.0. INFERRAIL_API_KEY enables read_page and
  read_pages. INFERRAIL_WALLET_KEY enables wallet Web Read, check_packages and lookup_domain.
  INFERRAIL_MAX_USD_PER_DAY defaults to 0.10 per UTC day, persisted locally across restarts.
  This is a local server boundary, not an account-wide limit across separate processes.
- Claude Desktop extension 0.3.0:
  https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/releases/tag/web-read-desktop-v0.3.0
  MCP Registry Web Read entry 1.2.0 is published. Read-only gateway entry is separate.
- Agent skills: npx skills add domondi1/inferrail. Claude Code plugin:
  /plugin install inferrail --marketplace domondi1/inferrail. Skills describe authorized
  wallet use; installation does not create/fund a wallet. Directory integration is not endorsement.
- Recurring workflows: https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/tree/main/examples/web_read
  CI package checks: https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/tree/main/actions/package-check
- Apify: ten verified public pay-per-event Actors, separate billing and inputs from native
  APIs. https://tryinferrail.com/tools/ links each listing and billing unit. Platform/account
  fees and limits can apply; Inferrail credits do not fund Apify.

## Inference spending controls (separate product)

- Hosted: POST /hosted/v1/chat/completions (OpenAI) or /hosted/v1/messages (Anthropic).
  Guide: https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/hosted/llms.txt. Workspace-shared run
  budgets, customer-provided OpenAI/Anthropic key. 250 runs a month free per workspace, then
  $0.001 per qualifying governed run; provider spend separate. A run must get at least one
  provider answer to be billed. Prepaid card or USDC credits, no subscription or auto top-up.
  Experimental pricing. Only calls routed through Hosted are governed.
- Self-hosted: pip install inferrail==0.4.18. Apache-2.0, developer preview. OpenAI chat
  completions and Anthropic messages, streaming, tool-call passthrough, budget reservations,
  local receipts/dashboard. No dependency on an Inferrail-operated service. No Responses,
  embeddings, image generation, native Gemini or Bedrock APIs. Conservative admission estimates
  can be exceeded by actual provider usage; overrun is recorded and later calls refused.
- Read-only MCP: inferrail mcp; get_spend/get_health only. It cannot buy external tools.
  Gateway receipts exclude prompt/response bodies; provider still sees requests, and caller
  tags are stored as sent. Web Read content retention is separate.

## Repository-specific gateway references

The Python package installs the self-hosted inference gateway. Its root openapi.json is
generated from that app, not the production evidence catalog. Gateway-only contracts:
- https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/blob/main/openapi.json
- https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/blob/main/config.schema.json
- https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/blob/main/ERRORS.md
- https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/blob/main/docs/self-hosting.md
- https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/blob/main/docs/PRODUCT.md
- https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/blob/main/docs/integrations.md

Offline evaluation: inferrail demo (fake provider, labelled DEMO prices, no network or key).
Real provider use requires your own credentials and incurs provider charges. Configure shared
budgets through inferrail serve --quickstart or inferrail.start(); attach a work ID and ceiling
to each call in a run. inferrail work <work_id> reports its known cost; unknown prices remain
unknown. inferrail verify-payload-free inspects the receipt schema, not an external audit.
